purpose: Bind the complete CP101 TL3 base candidate table to the CP102 executable construction/progression/integrated-combat consumers without changing accepted TL3 values or implying calibration/promotion.

runtimeBindings.hull: 36-Space capacity is consumed by v7 construction legality; lower-TL 35-Space Hull remains distinct.
runtimeBindings.tacticalComputer: EvComp5 is carried on the build and reduces only own Evasive direct-fire penalty to a minimum of zero; condition state applies.
runtimeBindings.sensor: Low 3/4 @1 TP and High 4/5 @2 TP are separate data-driven normal operating levels; High is not Strain-producing overload. CP102 transition variants keep sensor overload disabled.
runtimeBindings.ecmEccm: Rating2 remains non-additive; an explicit full-strength normal-cost field permits TL3 1 TP total without changing legacy 1 TP/rating semantics.
runtimeBindings.reactor: 6 TP per reactor at 5 Space; multiple reactors remain explicit and additive under existing condition logic.
runtimeBindings.stl: Move3 flows into the tactical movement override; existing bounded overload costs/Strain remain unchanged.
runtimeBindings.ftl: Strategic Move3 is represented on the executable build; strategic campaign integration remains outside the tactical smoke.
runtimeBindings.shieldHardener: Optional 1-Space damageable component; while functional and powered at 1 TP it contributes SA1. It requires an installed Shield Generator and does not stack with the selected auxiliary hardener path.
runtimeBindings.armor: AP1/AI5 flows through independent armor overrides.
runtimeBindings.kineticMain: ordinary Kinetic firing uses 0 discretionary TP while packet/range/ammunition remain held.
runtimeBindings.energyMain: Low 1TP/DAM2/+10, Standard 2TP/DAM3/+25, and High 3TP/DAM4/+25 remain explicit safe rated modes. CP102 transition smoke selects High to exercise the new path; deterministic tests cover Low and High family-local overrides. Tactical mode-selection UI/AI remains future work.
runtimeBindings.missileMain: Move4 and standard onboard navigation-sensor presence are represented; seeker remains optional and no detailed navigation-sensor track statistics are invented. Ordinary terminal Firm requirements remain unchanged.
runtimeBindings.energyPds: base16/RC1 becomes ready at 1 TP; ammunition remains unlimited.
runtimeBindings.ammPds: preferred readiness 2 TP -> RC2 automatically falls back to 1 TP -> RC1 when only one TP is available; seeded automatic target allocation and two-attempt-per-flight cap remain unchanged.

deferred: Tactical UI/player controls for choosing Energy rated mode
Sensor overload beyond TL3 High Active
